title: I LOVE THIS BUT I HATE IT
text:
I LOVE THIS BUT I HATE IT. I love this for its style/sturdiness and I even bought it in several colors BUT the hole for the stick gets STUCK and it’s impossible to clean so you cannot put another incense stick in it. I’ve tried tweezers/safety pins- everything but it’s impossible. So I end up making a hole so big it won’t hold a stick again!
I wish they’d figure something out! Because it’s truly one of the best holders out there! I LOVE the width! I love it in white! It’s not a cheesy incense holder- but it’s ridiculous that the ends get stuck!!!!!
Help!!!!
